description: Baseline: XGBoost with scale_pos_weight, StandardScaler, n_estimators=200, max_depth=4, lr=0.1

asi.hypothesis: Baseline XGBoost with scale_pos_weight. Starting point for optimization.

description: SMOTE oversampling: precision collapsed from 0.77 to 0.30, F1 dropped from 0.78 to 0.45

asi.hypothesis: SMOTE would improve minority class detection
asi.rollback_reason: SMOTE created too many false positives. The model learned to label everything as fraud. SMOTE generates synthetic fraud samples from only 378 real ones, creating unrealistic patterns.
asi.next_action_hint: Try threshold optimization instead — find optimal decision boundary for F1 maximization rather than resampling.

description: Added optimal threshold tuning on validation set: F1 0.78→0.84, precision 0.77→0.99

asi.hypothesis: Optimal threshold tuning on validation split would improve F1 by better balancing precision/recall
asi.insight: With extreme imbalance, models output very low probabilities for fraud. The default 0.5 threshold is far too low — the optimal threshold is near the edge of the distribution at 0.99.

description: Deeper trees + doubled scale_pos_weight: F1 dropped 0.84→0.83, recall worsened to 0.72

asi.hypothesis: Deeper trees (max_depth 6) and 2x scale_pos_weight would improve recall
asi.rollback_reason: Both recall and F1 decreased. Deeper trees may have overfit on the small fraud sample. scale_pos_weight=ratio already well-calibrated.
asi.next_action_hint: Try feature engineering instead — interaction features between Amount and V features, or polynomial features.

description: Feature engineering: Amount×V interactions, Amount_log, Amount², Time cyclical, Amount quantile. F1 0.84→0.85, recall 0.73→0.78

asi.hypothesis: Interaction features between Amount and V-features would help the model identify fraud patterns involving transaction amount
asi.technique: Amount×V interactions, Amount transformations, Time cyclical encoding, Amount quantile
asi.insight: Feature engineering boosted recall from 0.73 to 0.78 while keeping precision at 0.94. Optimal threshold dropped from 0.99 to 0.75, suggesting the model now produces more discriminative probability scores. 36 new features added (28 interactions + 3 transforms + 2 time + 1 quantile + existing).
